title: OS command execution via System.cmd (elixir) — review required
description: The elixir sink System.cmd launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via System.cmd with an args list.
remediation: Use System.cmd with an args list with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any System.cmd call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
